query_normalized: llmxive follow-up: extending "agentic environment engineering for large language models: a survey of" linguistics
rationale: This paper satisfies criteria (d) and (f) as a foundational survey on prompt engineering methodologies and a canonical reference for the "agentic environment" domain, providing the necessary methodological baseline and alternative-vocabulary cluster (goal-oriented prompting vs. agentic engineering) for a literature review on extending LLM interaction frameworks.
